shortDescription: In the week through Oct. 17, a seasonally adjusted 194,000 people filed new unemployment claims, down from 200,000 the week before. "Low Jobless Claims Signal Solid Labor Market — WSJ," at 9:25 a.m. ET, incorrectly said the previous week's number was 199,000.
